channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: Holiday classic ‘Planes, Trains and Automobiles’ has ‘dangerous’ capitalist message: professor
item.description: A SUNY professor recently criticized the film "Planes, Trains and Automobiles" for promoting a pro-capitalist message that normalizes classism.

item.title: Nine in ten college students think ‘words can be violence’: survey
item.description: Nine out of ten undergraduate students think that “words can be violence” at least “somewhat,” according to a new Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression survey. The poll also showed that ideological gaps between left-leaning and right-leaning students are widening. item.title: U. Colorado med school to pay $10 million after refusing COVID jab exemptions for Catholics
item.description: University of Colorado's medical school learned that Catholics also have religious freedom rights.

item.title: Some California colleges still ban showing Native American cultural items in class
item.description: Some California colleges continue to ban the display of Native American cultural items in classrooms, which one professor says is limiting experiential learning.

item.title: Princeton hit with Title IX complaint over gender-neutral communal bathrooms
item.description: An education watchdog group recently filed a civil rights complaint with the U.S. Department of Education against Princeton University over the school’s gender-neutral communal bathrooms. A spokesperson for Defending Education told The College Fix the group hopes its complaint will set a precedent for all higher education institutions. item.title: Pitt to remove ‘negative comments’ from faculty surveys
item.description: University of Pittsburgh professors will be able to ask for 'harmful' and 'negative comments' to be removed from their student evaluations under a new policy.

item.title: WATCH: Florida thinks professors should publish syllabi publicly. Do students agree?
item.description: A proposed Florida law aims to mandate professors to publicly publish their course syllabi. College Fix video journalist Abigail Nichols went to the Florida-Georgia game to ask students what they think about the proposed law.

item.title: Princeton criticized for ‘overly restrictive’ ban on recording events
item.description: Princeton University is considering a new policy that would prohibit unauthorized recording at off-campus events as well as school functions where permission has not explicitly been granted.

item.title: Depicting Jesus as white has some academics upset. But it shouldn’t.
item.description: The portrayal of Jesus varies widely across cultures, reflecting creativity and personal connections rather than exclusion.

item.title: ‘Spiritual hunger’: Pitt student ministry draws 600 to worship, baptism
item.description: A recent surge in college students embracing Christianity is evident at the University of Pittsburgh, where the Pitt Purpose ministry drew over 600 attendees for a baptism and worship service.
